The HWPX document generation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward by correctly mapping supplier data to the XML-based document structure.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the pytest suite in test_output.py without exceptions. Success was driven by the accurate manipulation of HWPX internal XML components, though the judge_reward of 0.82 suggests potential for refinement in document styling or metadata handling. Future iterations should re-check XML namespace consistency to avoid corruption in complex HWPX schemas.
